texts: In the 1999 movie 'Toy Story 2', Rex indeed asks, "How do you spell 'FBI'?" and then messes up Mr. Potato Head's crime scene setup.

That is correct, in the movie 'Toy Story 2' (1999), Rex asks 'How do you spell FBI?' which causes the other toys, specifically Mr. Potato Head, to mess up the crime scene they were trying to recreate.

The correct spelling of "FBI" is F-B-I. Rex's spelling, "FBE," was indeed incorrect, which led to some comedic moments in "Toy Story 2" when he messed up Mr. Potato Head's crime scene reenactment. This scene is a classic example of Rex's often hapless nature and his occasional misunderstanding of words and tasks.

In the movie "Toy Story 2," Rex actually spelled FBI as "F-L-B-I" while reenacting a crime scene with Mr. Potato Head. This is a humorous plot point, as Rex is a dinosaur and not human, so he doesn't have inherent knowledge about the correct spelling of FBI. This scene underscores the creativity and imagination that the characters display when playing. The correct spelling of FBI is "F-B-I."
